AGENDA
PLANNING COMMISSION
MEETING
Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at (310) 378-0383, at least 48 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
Any person who has made campaign contributions to any of the members of the Planning Commission within twelve months before this meeting, should examine the provisions of Government Code Section 84308 which is posted on the bulletin board outside the Council Chamber.
We are advised by the members of the Commission that none of them have received campaign contributions within the last twelve months.
The applicant or any property owner entitled to notice of the hearing may, within fifteen days after the date of the Planning Commission decision, appeal the Planning Commission decision to the City Council (Ord. No. 091-529). A fee is required for filing an appeal with the City Clerkâ€™s office (R05-14).
The Council may, within fifteen days after the date of the decision or on or before the first date following the first Council meeting after the date of the Planning Commission decision, whichever occurs last: 1) Confirm the action of the Planning Commission and grant or deny the application; 2) Set the matter for public hearing and dispose of it in the same manner as on an appeal; or 3) Amend, modify, delete or add any condition of approval which the Council finds is not substantial under the circumstances relative to or affecting the property subject to the application for a development entitlement. Any determination of the Council pursuant to this paragraph shall be conclusive and final.
The Planning Commission reserves the right to modify the order of items shown on the agenda and advises all interested parties to arrive promptly at the commencement of the meeting.

ACTION MINUTES
  PLANNING COMMISSION
  APRIL 21, 2020

Council Chambers  Tuesday
City Hall  April 21, 2020
340 Palos Verdes Drive West  6:30 p.m.
Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274

CALL TO ORDER

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL

Present:  Wade, Roos, Walker, Lazarro
Absent:  Criley
Also present: Acting City Manager, Community Development & Public Works Director, & City Engineer
  Ken Rukavina,
  Planning Manager Brianna Rindge,
  Planner Maddie Bright,
  Assistant City Attorney John Cotti

COMMUNICATIONS FROM PUBLIC

  Speakers: None

CONSENT CALENDAR

1.  M-1359-20 (RESOLUTION NO. PCR-2020-1168); Consideration of a Miscellaneous Application
  for structures exceeding 42” in a setback adjacent to a street at the single-family residence located
  at 1401 Via Arco. Lot 5, Block 4, Tract 8043. This project is exempt from CEQA pursuant to
  California Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.

  Applicant: Grace Luo, 904 Silver Spur Rd #628, Rolling Hills Estates, CA 90274
  Owner: Gene Kim

  Speakers: None

  Action: Roos moved and Wade seconded to approve the application (4-0 in favor; Criley absent)
  with standard conditions.

4.  NC-1537RII-19 (RESOLUTION NO. PCR-2020-1171); Consideration of a Neighborhood
  Compatibility Revision for modifications to a previously approved Neighborhood Compatibility
  application for a existing single-family residence located at 3900 Via Palomino. Lot 2, Block 6231,
  Tract 6887. This project is exempt from CEQA pursuant to California Administrative Code Title
  14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.

  Applicant: Kerry Olson, 61980 Tyler St, Thermal, CA 92274
  Owner: John Rogers
Action Minutes  Page 1 of 5
April 21, 2020 Planning Commission Meeting  City of Palos Verdes Estates
   Speakers: None

  Action: Roos moved and Wade seconded to approve the application (4-0 in favor; Criley absent)
  with standard conditions and the following conditions: 1) The driveway approach shall be constructed
  per City Standards as approved by the City Engineer; the driveway width shall be modified, if
  necessary, to protect the existing trees in the right-of-way; and 2) Any work performed adjacent the
  trees in the right-of-way shall be approved by the City Urban Forester.

5.  M-1361-20 (RESOLUTION NO. PCR-2020-1172); Consideration of a Miscellaneous Application
  for a structure exceeding 8’ at the single-family residence located at 4400 Via Pinzon. Lot 1, Block
  6333, Tract 7143. This project is exempt from CEQA pursuant to California Administrative Code
  Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.

  Applicant: Cauthen Design, 25332 Narbonne Ave #100, Lomita, CA 90717
  Owner: Scot & Erin Steenolsen

  Speakers: None

  Action: Roos moved and Wade seconded to approve the application (3-0 in favor; Wade recused;
  Criley absent) with standard conditions.

6.  NC-1670/M-1377-20 (RESOLUTION NO. PCR-2020-1174); Consideration of Neighborhood
  Compatibility and Miscellaneous Applications for additions to an existing single-family residence
  located at 2724 Via Anita. Lot 30, Block 1703, Tract 6882. This project is exempt from CEQA
  pursuant to California Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.

  Applicant: Michelle Gainer, PO Box 1448, Torrance, CA 90505
  Owner: Thattai & Kavita Sudarsan

  Speakers: None

  Action: Roos moved and Wade seconded to approve the application (3-0 in favor; Walker recused;
  Criley absent) with standard conditions and the following conditions: 1) The project shall include the
  construction of Valmonte P.V. Stone Curb along the frontage of the property; the curb shall be
  constructed per PVE Standard ST-29; 2) The new walkway shall be constructed per City standard; the
  first 5 feet of the walkway, from edge of pavement towards the property line, shall be constructed at a
  slope no greater than 2.0%; and 3) There appears to be an existing sewer easement on the property; the
  developer confirm whether or not an existing sewer easement exists; no object, whether a permanent
  structure, or a temporary structure, or any object which is difficult to remove is allowed within the
  sewer easements.

7.  M-1373-20 (RESOLUTION NO. PCR-2020-1175); Consideration of a Miscellaneous Application
  for structures exceeding 42” within a setback adjacent to street and for structures exceeding 6.5’ at
  the existing single-family residence located at 560 Via Media. Lot 2, Block 1412, Tract 6886. This
  project is exempt from CEQA pursuant to California Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3,
  Section 15303.

  Applicant: Fabio Rigo de Righi, 226 S Beverly Dr #220, Beverly Hills, CA 90212
  Owner: Brad & Natalia Hofman
Action Minutes  Page 2 of 5
April 21, 2020 Planning Commission Meeting  City of Palos Verdes Estates
   Speakers: None

  Action: Roos moved and Wade seconded to approve the application (4-0 in favor; Criley absent)
  with standard conditions.

BUSINESS

2.  M-1370-20 (RESOLUTION NO. PCR-2020-1169); Consideration of a Miscellaneous Application
  for an accessory structure exceeding 8’ at the single-family residence located at 1608 Chelsea Road.
  Lot 12, Block 1272, Tract 7140. This project is exempt from CEQA pursuant to California
  Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.

  Applicant/Owner: Lynn & Eric Kim

  Speakers: Priscilla Adler

  Action: Walker moved and Wade seconded to deny the application (4-0 in favor; Criley absent) with
  the requirement to remove the structure within six months and that, within those six months, the
  structure may only be used between 9:00 a.m. and 5:00 p.m.

3.  NC-1672/G-1638-20 (RESOLUTION NO. PCR-2020-1170); Consideration of Neighborhood
  Compatibility and Grading Applications for a new single-family residence located at 344 Via
  Almar. Lot 11, Block 1611, Tract 6885. This project is exempt from CEQA pursuant to California
  Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.

  Applicant: Jeff Dahl, 1102 Main St, Huntington Beach, CA 92648
  Owner: Zhenwen Liu & Mei Zhang, 54 Cortland, Irvine, CA 92620

  Speakers: John Gilligan, Janine Nendick

  Action: Wade moved and Walker seconded to approve the application (4-0 in favor; Criley absent)
  with standard conditions and the following conditions: 1) The civil drainage design shall comply with
  low impact development guidelines. Run off shall be diverted to vegetated areas before discharge; 2)
  At the area labeled “storage” in the basement, the distance between the basement finished floor to the
  first floor finished floor shall not exceed 7’ 6” and the floor-to-ceiling height in the storage room on the
  lowest floor shall not exceed 6’ 6”; and 3) the northeast corner of the home shall be set back 2 feet
  further from the front yard property line.

8.  M-1360-19 (RESOLUTION NO. PCR-2020-1161); Consideration of a Miscellaneous Application
  for a nonstandard encroachment at the single-family residence located at 744 Cloyden Road. Lot
  16, Block 1276, Tract 7140. This project is exempt from CEQA pursuant to California
  Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.

  Applicant/Owner/Appellant: Dale Sanchez

  Speakers: None

  Action: Continued.

Action Minutes  Page 3 of 5
April 21, 2020 Planning Commission Meeting  City of Palos Verdes Estates
 10.  NC-1665-19, G-1634-19 & M-1358-19 (RESOLUTION NO. PCR-2019-1160); Consideration of
  Neighborhood Compatibility, Grading & Miscellaneous Applications for a new single-family
  residence located at 2220 Via La Brea. Lot 10, Block 1651, Tract 7330. This project is exempt
  from CEQA pursuant to California Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.

  Applicant: Tomaro Architecture, 2617 N. Sepulveda Blvd, Manhattan Beach, CA 90266
  Owner: Garrett & Janet Stearns

  Speakers: David Kelliny, Morgan Tam, Julia Tam, Tom Bechler, Stella Chang, William Lyons

  Action: Walker moved and Wade seconded to approve the application (3-1 in favor; Roos
  dissenting; Criley absent) with standard conditions and the following conditions: 1) The civil
  drainage design shall comply with Low-Impact Development guidelines. A minimum of 0.5% slope is
  required down to the street for drainage.

11.  NC-1668/G-1635/M-1386/SC-140-19 (RESOLUTION NO. PCR-2020-1173); Consideration of
  Neighborhood Compatibility, Grading, Miscellaneous & Sports Court Applications for a new
  single-family residence located at 2014 Via Cerritos. Lot 3, Block 5, Tract 8043. This project is
  exempt from CEQA pursuant to California Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.

  Applicant: Luis de Moraes, Envirotechno Architecture, 116 S. Catalina Ave #102, Redondo Beach,
  CA 90277
  Owner: Varsha Patel

  Speakers: Eric Cheng, Steve Shimoyama, Robert Thornburgh, Karen Thornburgh

  Action: Continued.

9.  NC-1660-19, G-1632-19, & M-1354-19 (RESOLUTION NO. PCR-2019-1154); Consideration
  of Neighborhood Compatibility, Grading & Miscellaneous Applications for a new single-family
  residence located at 2321 Via Acalones. Lot 20, Block 1638, Tract 7330. This project is exempt
  from CEQA pursuant to California Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.

  Applicant: Pritzkat & Johnson Architects, Inc., 306 Vista Del Mar A, Redondo Beach, CA 90277
  Owner: Steve & Amy Hogan

  Speakers: Lorna Interian, Burt Walker, George Winston, Marci Winston-Beech, Robin Winston,
  Sandra Winston, Elizabeth Staes, Anthony Poon, David Kelliny, Mary Kelliny, Norman Eagle,
  Diane Staes, Christina Hogan, Jennifer Payne, Sean Armstrong, Bill Morino, Roger Yang, Carol
  Ferdows, Mandi Leonard, Tim Zigrang, Jack Luftman, James McBirney, Jennifer Choi, Diana
  Gdowski, Janine Nendick, Gayle Probst, Mark Sharp

  Action: Continued.

12.  Annual Conditional Use Permit Review

  Action: Continued.

ITEMS OF INFORMATION

Action Minutes  Page 4 of 5
April 21, 2020 Planning Commission Meeting  City of Palos Verdes Estates
 13.  Administrative Approvals – Reviewed and filed.

14.  Art Jury Meeting Schedule – Reviewed and filed.

ACTION MINUTES

15.  Meeting of February 18, 2020.

  Action: Wade moved and Walker seconded to receive and file (4-0 in favor; Criley absent).

Adjourned at 2:25 A.M.

Action Minutes  Page 5 of 5
April 21, 2020 Planning Commission Meeting  City of Palos Verdes Estates
